messages:
lina_support: :rotating_light: Escalation from Acme via email — after today's router liverefresh the customer's tool calls sometimes don't fire and when they do args are scrambled. Repro attached.

sam_eng: Can you paste the minimal repro and the raw request+response? Also which rollout shard? @deploy-bot which commit rolled out at 10:15 UTC?

deploy-bot: Rolled commit 9f3b2a1 to route-service (canary=40%) at 2026-03-16T10:15:12Z

lina_support: Repro steps:
1) curl to hosted API w/ JSON payload below
2) ask model to call tool 'translate' with 'text' and 'lang'
3) sometimes response has missing 'lang' or lang in 'text'

lina_support: ```
POST /v1/chat
{
  "model": "gpt-mini-serve",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Translate to fr: Hello"}],
  "tools": [{"name": "translate", "schema": {"text": "string", "lang": "string"}}]
}
```

lina_support: Example response we saw:
```
{"id":"r1","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","tool_call":{"name":"translate","arguments":{"text":"fr","lang":null}}}}]}
```

marcus_se: That's weird — lang moved into text and lang null. Any differences in model variant? Can you repro on Dedicated or only hosted?

lina_support: Only started after canary. Customer repros on hosted us-east region. They tried pinning model to v2.1 but still sees issue.

anya_ml: Could be argument-serializer change in router->fnbridge handoff. Sam, can you check PR 1234 (arg marshalling) that landed yesterday?

sam_eng: Looking. I see a change altering JSON order to use OrderedDict in one path. Might cause our tool-arg parser to assume positional mapping. Reproducing locally now.

sam_eng: Quick dump from router logs when request hit faulty path:
```
IN: tools=[{"name":"translate","args":"text=fr;lang=Hello"}]
OUT: fn_call name=translate args_parsed={"text":"fr","lang":null}
```

ops_oncall_bot: Alert: 3 similar customer reports in last 30m (inc: Acme). Severity set to high.

sam_eng: I have a hypothesis: the serializer switched delimiter from JSON to semicolon-separated for a fallback path. Fix: revert that fallback and add strict JSON enforcement. Will patch canary now.

lina_support: Customer asked for ETA, they're blocked in production. Any chance for immediate canary rollback?

marcus_se: Canary rollback scheduled. @deploy-bot please rollback route-service canary to previous stable.

deploy-bot: Rolling back commit 9f3b2a1 -> previous 7a8e6d (canary=0%). Started 2026-03-16T11:02:03Z

lina_support: Thanks — I told customer we rolled back and to validate. Will update when they confirm.

anya_ml: Follow-up: add a unit test for mixed-encoding tool args and add a regression alert to Optimize that fires on arg-shape drift.

sam_eng: Patch PR 1240 open, tests added. Marking incident as mitigated after rollback.

lina_support: Confirmed with customer — tool calls restored. Closing escalation. :white_check_mark:
